topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Mutation Progression
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's learning objectives and the overarching framework of cancer hallmarks and multistep mutation progression.

topics.label: Growth Signaling Cascades and Pathway Deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how oncogenic mutations deregulate extracellular sensor pathways and intracellular cascades—including Wnt, RTK, and TGF-beta signaling—to drive sustained proliferation and cell survival.

topics.label: Terminal Differentiation Blocks in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how malignant cells fail to execute normal lineage maturation and exit the cell cycle, using hematopoiesis and colonic crypt renewal as models.

topics.label: Apoptosis Evasion, Replicative Immortality, and p53 Regulation
topics.groupedBecause: They detail how tumor cells bypass cell death and proliferative limits through evasion of apoptosis, telomerase reactivation, and subversion of p53-mediated stress responses.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Oncometabolites in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They explore the biochemical alterations of cancer metabolism, including aerobic glycolysis, metabolic rewiring across cancer types, and oncometabolite-induced epigenetic modifications.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: It details how growing tumors trigger the angiogenic switch to develop new vasculature for oxygen and nutrient perfusion.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Clonal Dynamics of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the systemic dissemination of cancer cells, covering the metastatic cascade, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, circulating tumor cells, and genomic duplication in metastatic clones.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture by synthesizing the hallmarks framework, recommending further reading, and closing with final remarks.
